title: refactor(app-shell): move the Data, Automations and Access pillars out of StudioDesignSurface.tsx (move-only)
body:

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBTuMGhLAZx29zwDrayDGZZF)_

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：用户无感，Studio 设计界面的行为与外观不变，只是代码换了文件存放。
- 为什么做：属于「Studio 重构」专题；把八千行的设计界面大文件按数据、自动化、访问三个分区拆开，让后面左侧菜单和三个设计器的改动可以并行，不再排队改同一个文件。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是 Studio 某个分区打不开或报错，所有在 Studio 里设计应用的管理员都会立刻看到；改动是纯搬移，可以整体直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：审阅并亲手合并这个草稿（改动行数超过三千，按规则需要你本人合并）。

## What changes

Move-only split of `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (SDS), the whole card in one PR: all three pillars. SDS goes from 8,010 lines (at base `62692b7f8`) to 1,715.

| New module | Moved from SDS at `62692b7f8` | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `DataPillar.tsx` | lines 1973-4899 (2,927 lines) | `renderStudioGridList` (the records-grid slot), `ObjDraftSend`, `DataPillar` |
| `AutomationsPillar.tsx` | lines 4904-6978 (2,075 lines) | `readPublishedFlowNames`, `AutomationsPillar` |
| `AccessPillar.tsx` | lines 1947-1971 (25) and 6980-8008 (1,029) | `StudioNameLabel`, `NewSimilarStrip`, `NEW_SIMILAR_ARRIVAL_STATE`, `readNewSimilarArrival`, `AccessPillar` |

- **Move only.** Each moved block is byte-identical to its text at the base; the check is below. Each new file is a header comment, its imports, and the moved blocks, nothing else. No `export` was added or removed: the three pillars and `renderStudioGridList` were already exported, and the other helpers stay private to their module.
- **Helpers.** Every helper that moved is used only by the pillar it moved with: `StudioNameLabel` only by `AccessPillar`, `ObjDraftSend` and `renderStudioGridList` only by `DataPillar`, `readPublishedFlowNames` only by `AutomationsPillar`. No helper used by two pillars or by the shell existed in this text, so nothing went to a shared module.
- **No cycle.** The new modules import nothing from SDS. SDS imports the three pillars and re-exports them, plus `renderStudioGridList` for `StudioDesignSurface.gridRefresh.test.tsx`, so every import path stays the same. The test files that import the pillars are not edited.
- **SDS diff = deletions + re-exports.** It removes the blocks and the import names only they used, trims five single-line imports, and adds three import lines for the new modules and three re-export lines with comments. The `FlowStatusDot` re-export pair shows as moved only because the text around it was deleted. The import names in each file come from the TypeScript checker's own noUnusedLocals result: 0 unused at base, 0 in each of the four files at head.
- **By-path readers** (ruling 6597555122 item 3), all three updated in this PR:
  - `homeRecoveryRedirectsFollowDeclaration-7373.test.ts`: the Studio site's `alsoReads` gains the three modules.
  - `ui/scripts/__tests__/spec-symbol-ledger-app-shell-7265.test.ts`: `SITES` gains the three modules.
  - `clickableNonControlCensus-13461.test.ts`: six rows are re-keyed from SDS to the module their site moved into. Data has the two canvas backgrounds, the rail scrim and the form-preview click; Automations and Access each have their rail scrim. The keys and reasons are unchanged.
- One root changeset, `.changeset/36893-sds-pillar-split.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell` patch), carrying both declaration lines.
- History on the branch: slice 1 (Automations, Access) was committed first. Then `origin/main` was merged in after PR 36888 landed. The single conflicting line was in the `StudioCustomizeControls` import: `withoutReplacedPlacements` from main was kept, and `type CustomizeBlock` was dropped, because its only reader moved out with `AutomationsPillar`. The Data pillar move came after that merge, measured against the merged text.

**Read first** (by risk):
1. SDS, the import block and the three re-export lines at the end of the file. This is where a missing re-export would break an importer.
2. `clickableNonControlCensus-13461.test.ts`, the six re-keyed rows.
3. `DataPillar.tsx`, its import block. It is the largest pruned import list.

## Tests

<details><summary>Verbatim check: all four blocks against base 62692b7f8</summary>

```bash
B=62692b7f8; D=ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design
for spec in 'AccessPillar 1947 1971' 'DataPillar 1973 4899' 'AutomationsPillar 4904 6978' 'AccessPillar 6980 8008'; do
  set -- $spec
  git show $B:$D/StudioDesignSurface.tsx | sed -n "$2,$3p" > /tmp/blk
  node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),c=require("crypto");const b=fs.readFileSync("/tmp/blk","utf8");const f=fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8");const i=f.indexOf(b);console.log(process.argv[1].split("/").pop()+": base lines "+process.argv[2]+" ("+(b.split("\n").length-1)+" lines, sha256 "+c.createHash("sha256").update(b).digest("hex").slice(0,16)+"): "+(i===-1?"MISSING":(f.indexOf(b,i+1)===-1?"verbatim, once, from line "+f.slice(0,i).split("\n").length:"DUPLICATE")))' $D/$1.tsx $2-$3
done
```

```text

AccessPillar.tsx: base lines 6980-8008 (1029 lines, sha256 aa6b436a3bcacc05): verbatim, once, from line 87
```

The complementary check: with the moved blocks removed, each new file has 0 lines left that are not header or import lines (Access 0, Automations 0, Data 0). The Automations and Access blocks are also byte-identical to their text at `3f568c1a4`, where slice 1 was first cut (same sha256 values), so the field-layout PR changed none of that text.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Tier H by size**: 6,516 additions + 6,316 deletions = 12,832 changed lines. Draft, waiting for the maintainer. No AI seat readies, queues or arms it.
- `renderStudioGridList` moved with its own `eslint-disable-next-line react-refresh/only-export-components` line, which still applies in `DataPillar.tsx`. SDS's re-export of it now draws that rule's warning once (warn, not error, so no gate fails). Adding a matching directive to SDS would be a new line rather than a move, so this PR leaves it out. It is a one-line follow-up if wanted.
- Open PR 36784 (paused) conflicts in SDS. It already conflicts with `origin/main` without this branch (merge-tree exit 1), so this PR does not cause that conflict.
- Prose that still names SDS for text that has moved, outside this card's file surface, noted and not filed: source citations in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/{automation,studio-authoring,access-security}.json` that name SDS for pillar behaviour; the producer prose in `packages/spec/liveness/permission.json` (the Access pillar mounts the permission page); and the `StudioDesignSurface.tsx:2575` line citation in `ui/packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx`. None is read by a gate (the checklist gate found no anchored file).

## Verification

Two-minute check: run the verbatim-check script above from the repo root on this branch. Expect four lines, each ending `verbatim, once, from line N`. A `MISSING` or `DUPLICATE` line means the move is not verbatim.
